outfit.name: 涩谷高街短款皮夹克与粉黑格纹裙
outfit.prose: A cropped boxy black biker jacket in matte faux leather over a ribbed halter crop top, paired with a pleated low-waist pink-and-black tartan micro skirt and tiered silver waist chains. Her toned bare thigh is cinched by a wide black punk leather leg garter with chrome eyelets, worn with fishnet over-knee socks and platform combat boots.
